title: Pretty but a pain to open and close
text: Pretty but a pain to open and close. I liked how it looked but it was a pain to open and close. I did manage it, but I had to push hard each time and it's just a hassle, especially with how often I change them. It worked fine, and once I got it opened or close it stayed that way. But just not sure it is worth dealing with it each time.
